source_text: In response to declining U.S. neonatal circumcision rates—dropping from approximately 65% in 2012 to around 60% by 2022 among certain demographics—pro-circumcision advocates, including urological societies, have launched informational initiatives underscoring parental rights to weigh cultural, hygienic, and preventive factors in diverse populations. [104]
